latest.author: animatian112
latest.text: Thank you! 4K is being actively worked on. Here's where it stands: • Decoding works: the app can now use the PS5's built-in video chip to decode 4K, and it handles a 4K frame in about 2 ms. Before this, everything ran on the CPU, which can't keep up above 1080p. • What's left: getting each decoded frame onto the screen. That step is still too slow, so 4K drops frames and the app steps back down to 1080p. The latest update tests faster ways to do it. If you'd like to help test, update the app an…

latest.author: animatian112
latest.text: Thanks! Passthrough isn't planned for now. It shines for movie files with Dolby/DTS tracks, but YouTube almost always serves stereo AAC/Opus, which TubeBlock already decodes at full quality, so passthrough would sound the same. If YouTube's few surround videos turn out to matter to people, 5.1 output could come later.
